parsed.note_claim: Cole Tomas Allen is the suspected shooter at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: A man taken into custody after gunfire rang out at the White House Correspondents' Assn. dinner on Saturday was identified by law enforcement sources as 31-year-old Cole Tomas Allen of Torrance.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that Cole Tomas Allen was identified by law enforcement as the shooting suspect at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.
